ayahOccurrences.text: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَٱصْدَعْ is in the derivative form: إصْدَع
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/د/ع   ṣ–d–ʿ to cleave, to split
; to cause a headache; to disperse, to scatter; to traverse, to cross from 1 side to the other, to journey; crack, fissure, cleavage; scattering, standing out; to comply with, to attain to.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
اصْدَعْ ʾiṣdaʿ; يَصَّدَّعون yaṣṣaddaʿūn; يُصَدَّعون yuṣaddaʿūn; مُتَصَدِّع mutaṣaddiʿ and صدع ṣadʿ.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
إصْدَع ʾiṣdaʿ [imper. v. with prep. ﺒ] attain to, comply with; reveal, distinguish between; disperse

(15:94) فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ so proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the polytheists.

entries.label: ص-د-ع
entries.definitionHtml:
ص/د/ع   ṣ–d–ʿ to cleave, to split
; to cause a headache; to disperse, to scatter; to traverse, to cross from 1 side to the other, to journey; crack, fissure, cleavage; scattering, standing out; to comply with, to attain to.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
اصْدَعْ ʾiṣdaʿ; يَصَّدَّعون yaṣṣaddaʿūn; يُصَدَّعون yuṣaddaʿūn; مُتَصَدِّع mutaṣaddiʿ and صدع ṣadʿ.

entries.label: إصْدَع
entries.definitionHtml:
إصْدَع ʾiṣdaʿ [imper. v. with prep. ﺒ] attain to, comply with; reveal, distinguish between; disperse

(15:94) فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ so proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the polytheists.

entries.label: صَدْع
entries.definitionHtml:
صَدْع ṣadʿ [n./v. n.] crack, split, fault

(86:12) وَالأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ by the earth splitting open [with the sprouting of trees and herbage, or with fissures and faults].

entries.label: مُتَصَدِّع
entries.definitionHtml:
مُتَصَدِّع mutaṣaddiʿ [act. part.] cracking, collapsing, splitting asunder

(59:21) لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هَذَا الْقُرْءَانَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ if We had sent this Qur’an down upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled, split asunder out of the fear of God.

entries.label: يَصَّدَّعون
entries.definitionHtml:
يَصَّدَّعون yaṣṣaddaʿūn (assimilated form of يَتَصَدَّعُون yataṣaddaʿūn) [imperf. v. VIII, intrans.] to crack up, to scatter away, to separate, to fragment

(30:43) فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لاَ مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ set your face [stand firm in your devotion] to the upright religion, before there comes, from God, a day which cannot be averted–on that Day, they [humankind] will fall.

entries.label: يُصَدَّعون
entries.definitionHtml:
يُصَدَّعون yuṣaddaʿūn [pass. imperf. of v. II] to be separated, to be caused to have a headache, hangover

(56:19) لاَ يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلاَ يُنْزِفُونَ from which they are caused neither headache nor intoxication.
